title: Coverage versus within-epoch repetition at matched dose in transformer grokking: code and data
description:
Training code, raw run logs (135 runs), canonical analysis tables, the exact-permutation statistical pipeline, and manuscript-verification scripts for a study of coverage and within-epoch repetition in transformer grokking on modular addition (p = 23), with the per-example dose held constant across repetition levels. The archived pipeline reproduces every statistic reported in the related manuscript.

Repository: https://github.com/43aquarius/grokking-coverage-vs-repetition — code under MIT; data files and figures under CC-BY-4.0.

related_identifiers.identifier: Manuscript DOI to be added after publication (Neural Processing Letters submission; submission package archived at https://github.com/43aquarius/grokking-coverage-vs-repetition/releases)
